Amumu.watch: Amumu Q Bandage Toss stops at the first target, so dodge it with a jungle monster between you and Amumu. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns in an area around him, so keep your distance before he gets close and avoid grouping with allies.
Amumu.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the range of Amumu W Despair. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Amumu Q Bandage Toss and W Despair, but avoid stacking only health because he deals damage based on your maximum health.
Amumu.fight: Cast Evelynn W Allure before approaching, then manage your distance until the mark matures. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, and avoid prolonged fights near Amumu W Despair.
Amumu.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. After reducing health, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Amumu.escape: Engage the moment Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy have both been fully spent. Amumu has no skill to create distance on his own, so use that window to lock him down with Evelynn W Allure and close in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
Amumu.phase: Even in the late game, keep to the sequence of engaging with Evelynn after Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, avoid grouping with allies and keep your distance in open terrain. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or rear. Once Amumu’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, go after the enemy backline carries. Pierce the grouped formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress, and escape.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it travels, so dodge it sideways. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can bring her back in, so create distance. Don’t fight up close until the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Diana’s damage. If you’re concerned about being counterattacked right after engaging, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and use it at a different time from Evelynn R Last Caress to survive.
Diana.fight: Start a fight after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, don’t continue the trade; create distance.
Diana.laning: When targeting Diana’s lane, choose a lane pushed toward the enemy turret to give Evelynn W Allure time to mature. Diana may escape with her mobility before the mark matures, so prioritize lanes where an ally’s crowd control lands first.
Diana.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Reduce health into execute range, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without using Q Crescent Strike, look for a chance to catch her with Evelynn W Allure while her mobility is on cooldown. If you were hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, Diana E Lunar Rush can bring her back in, so don’t engage; create distance.
Diana.phase: From mid game onward, Evelynn uses camouflage to approach from out of sight and look for charms and kills. In late-game teamfights, look for a flank angle.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from allies so multiple players aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and use vision to watch for Diana’s flank angles. Evelynn should avoid the front and activate Evelynn P Demon Shade to flank from the side or rear. Go after the backline carries once Diana’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes when you’re hit by his abilities in succession, so it’s important to dodge his first ability, Brand Q Sear or Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear’s projectile or hide behind minions. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from allies.
Brand.build: Brand’s main damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your maximum health, so consider movement speed to help you leave areas like Brand W Pillar of Flame rather than stacking only health.
Brand.fight: The window to engage is after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in.
Brand.laning: When Evelynn P Demon Shade is active, recover health and prepare for the next opportunity.
Brand.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Detonate the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm Brand, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If health has been reduced into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the distance once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and you can dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets who are ablaze, so being unlit is also an opportunity to engage.
Brand.phase: Early on, Evelynn has no camouflage and is weak at ganking, so focus on leveling up. The available information isn’t enough to judge which side has the advantage late game.
Brand.teamfight: Avoid the front and activate Evelynn P Demon Shade to flank from the side or rear. If an ally is ablaze, don’t stand beside them; when you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from allies. Engage after Brand’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, pierce the formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces resistances, so keep your distance to avoid being hit. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and makes you her prey, move toward your allies to fight back together rather than trying to escape alone.
Briar.build: Briar’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor if you’re building resistances. If Briar’s healing keeps ruining your execute opportunities, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item. If the counterattack right after you engage is overwhelming, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Briar.fight: While Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is active, she chases the nearest enemy, so approach from the side while your allies’ frontline absorbs her. Lower Briar’s health into execute range, then finish with R Last Caress and escape.
Briar.laning: Briar has high kill participation early and engages recklessly, so don’t stay long in areas without vision and check vision along gank routes.
Briar.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and only approach until the mark matures. Detonate the mark with Q Hate Spike to charm Briar, then dash in with empowered E Whiplash and recast Q Hate Spike. When Briar’s health enters execute range, finish with R Last Caress.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is on cooldown. Briar can also move with W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, so confirm that both abilities have been used, and especially look for an opportunity before R Certain Death comes back up. Watch out for the stun from Briar E Chilling Scream as well. When engaging, detonate an already-matured Evelynn W Allure with Q Hate Spike to lock down Briar’s movement.
Briar.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge which side is stronger late game, so watch for Briar’s engage and crowd control to be used in teamfights before making your move.
Briar.teamfight: Evelynn should avoid the front and activate Demon Shade to flank from the side or rear. If your frontline stands in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, Briar will have a harder time reaching the backline carries directly. Engage after Briar’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, pierce the grouped enemies with empowered E Whiplash, then finish with R Last Caress and disengage.

Ekko.watch: When you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s indicator, move out of its area to prevent its stun and Ekko’s shield. Also dodge the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t overcommit to the chase, even when health is low.
Ekko.build: Finish one core item first. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing keeps putting him out of execute range, buy Morellonomicon. Build magic resist rather than armor against Ekko’s magic damage. If you have no means of movement to avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s stun, consider tenacity first.
Ekko.fight: Start the main fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don’t overcommit because he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Right after he uses Ekko E Phase Dive to engage, he has no mobility available, so trigger the already-matured Evelynn W Allure to lock him down, then attack.
Ekko.laning: Choose a lane where your allies’ crowd control can land first, since Ekko can escape with Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ekko.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark charges. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Reduce health to execute range, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.
Ekko.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge your relative advantage late game. Keep looking for opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.teamfight: Evelynn shouldn’t show herself head-on; keep Demon Shade active and flank or circle behind. If you see Ekko W Parallel Convergence’s indicator, avoid its area, and engage after the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to engage, trigger the already-matured Evelynn W Allure to force him to use Ekko R Chronobreak or interrupt his movement.
Ekko.escape: Your opening comes when Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are both down. If he has just used Ekko E Phase Dive, trigger your pre-cast Evelynn W Allure and close the distance with Evelynn E Whiplash. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, watch for his afterimage and stop chasing.

Elise.build: Finish one core item first. If Elise’s magic damage is a problem, build magic resist. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen keeps putting her out of execute range, get Morellonomicon next to reduce her healing.
Elise.fight: Fight after both Elise E Cocoon and Spider Form’s E Rappel are down.
Elise.laning: Don’t push the lane recklessly when the enemy jungler is missing. Check whether allied lanes have minions that can block Elise E Cocoon.
Elise.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark charges. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Q to reduce health. Finish with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Elise.escape: The window to counter-engage opens right after both Elise E Cocoon and Spider Form’s E Rappel are down. Let Evelynn W Allure charge, charm her, and close the gap with Evelynn E Whiplash. Save Evelynn R Last Caress for finishing and disengaging rather than engaging.
Elise.phase: In the mid game, use Evelynn’s camouflage to approach from out of sight and look for kills. In the late game, prioritize flanking and waiting for the enemy’s crowd control to be used over fighting head-on.
Elise.teamfight: Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank or circle behind to get behind the enemy backline’s damage dealers. Engage after key crowd control like Elise E Cocoon has been used on your frontline, then pierce the grouped enemies with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. Finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Elise.watch: When your health has fallen and Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form, she is looking to finish you off. Use Evelynn R Last Caress's untargetability to dodge her attack.

Fiddlesticks.build: Finish one core item first. If healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest keeps putting him out of execute range, fit in Morellonomicon next. If you need defense, build magic resist against Fiddlesticks’ magic damage.
Fiddlesticks.fight: Fiddlesticks’ only mobility is Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, so when it’s down, cast Evelynn W Allure in advance and approach. If he channels Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest to completion, it heals for a lot, so interrupt it if you can time the charm to his channel.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark charges. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Reduce the target’s health to execute range, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Fiddlesticks.escape: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, he can’t escape with mobility, giving you an opening to engage. If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are also down, let Evelynn W Allure’s mark charge, charm him, and go in. If Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm has already started and you can’t interrupt it, don’t take the fight; leave its area.
Fiddlesticks.phase: In late-game teamfights, spread out to avoid taking Fiddlesticks’ area abilities together, and wait for a chance to flank.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Cast Evelynn W Allure on a large jungle monster first, then trigger it once the mark is primed. During gank timings, keep the brush behind the lane warded, and don’t pass beside a stationary Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow until you’ve checked it.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out so several teammates don’t get hit by Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, or Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, and don’t fight in narrow terrain. If Fiddlesticks is out of sight, secure vision in the bushes and approach paths near objectives. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or rear, entering once the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channels before entering, so if you see it being cast, decide whether you can interrupt it. If you can't, move out of range. Fiddlesticks' abilities apply fear when they hit you from out of vision, so be careful around bushes you have no vision of and narrow passages. Fiddlesticks E Reap silences enemies at the center of the formation, so don't stand in the middle.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius immediately. If Gragas E Body Slam also hits you near the barrel, you’ll take both abilities, so be careful in narrow passages and bushes without vision. While Gragas R Explosive Cask is available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy’s position behind you.
Gragas.build: Build magic resist to defend against Gragas Q Barrel Roll, W Drunken Rage, and E Body Slam. If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour keeps making execute opportunities unreliable, finish one core item, then fit in Morellonomicon.
Gragas.fight: Don’t unload your burst while Gragas drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage; wait for the damage reduction to end. Bait out Gragas E Body Slam, then cast Evelynn W Allure in advance and let it charge. Charm him, then go in with Evelynn E Whiplash. He can use E Body Slam again if you chase too deep, so only pursue when you can finish him for sure.
Gragas.laning: If Gragas E Body Slam is available, he can escape before the mark charges, so look for an opening when it’s down.
Gragas.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark charges. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve reduced his health to execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and back away.
Gragas.escape: Gragas E Body Slam is his mobility, so immediately after you make him use it is Evelynn’s chance to go in. If Gragas R Explosive Cask is still available, account for the direction it could knock you before engaging.
Gragas.phase: In the early and mid game, watch out for Gragas’ burst and ability to disrupt your formation. If you survive while holding your formation in early and mid-game objective fights, Gragas’ sustained damage falls off late game and the matchup improves.
Gragas.teamfight: Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank or circle behind to get behind the enemy backline’s damage dealers. Engage when key crowd control like Gragas E Body Slam has been used on your frontline, and stay out of Gragas Q Barrel Roll’s radius. Pierce the grouped formation with empowered E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle passages. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, it blocks your vision and slows you, so leave its area by the shortest route, then look for an angle again. Graves’s basic attacks are stopped by the first unit they hit, so keep an ally or minion between you in a skirmish.
Graves.build: Graves’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Getting Plated Steelcaps early helps in early and mid-game fights. Graves W Smoke Screen’s magic damage is not blocked by armor.
Graves.combo: Then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought their health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and fall back backward.
Graves.escape: Don’t go in just because Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown. Look for a chance to charm him by priming Evelynn W Allure before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up, especially after he uses a mobility ability. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, leave its area before engaging.
Graves.phase: You’ll be at a disadvantage as Graves builds up strength over time, so make the most of kill opportunities in the early and mid game.
Graves.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active as you circle around from the side or behind. Go in after the enemy uses key crowd control on your frontline, and look for an angle to pierce clustered enemies with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If you run into Graves, keep an ally between you to block his basic attacks, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Graves.fight: Fight in open terrain and look for the gap while Graves reloads after firing both shots. Don’t attack until Evelynn W Allure’s mark is primed.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks you back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward an ally when Hecarim changes direction while running. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, fighting near him for too long helps him heal, so burst him briefly or retreat outside its area. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so spread out from your allies.
Hecarim.build: Hecarim’s main damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge, is physical, so build armor first. If Hecarim W Spirit of Dread’s healing keeps ruining your execute opportunities, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, use Evelynn W Allure to slow Hecarim, reducing both his ability to approach and his attack damage. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and disengage after you’ve brought his health into execute range.
Hecarim.combo: Then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike to reduce health. Once it is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and fall back backward.
Hecarim.escape: Don’t go in recklessly when only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, since Hecarim can escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows. Look especially for the window before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up. Once he has also used Hecarim E Devastating Charge, prime Evelynn W Allure and charm him. Then close the gap with Evelynn E Whiplash and save Evelynn R Last Caress to finish him.
Hecarim.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who has the advantage late game, so watch for Hecarim’s engage in team fights and look for an angle to enter from the side.
Hecarim.teamfight: Space out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear several of you at once. Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active as you circle around from the side or behind, and go in after the enemy uses key crowd control on your frontline.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, his allies can dash in, so position with a minion or terrain between you before he casts it. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, change position to avoid being knocked up by her three consecutive attacks. Watch for ambushes as you pass beside newly created Ivern W Brushmaker brush.
Ivern.build: Ivern’s own damage is magic, so build magic resistance instead of armor. However, the main danger is allies following up on the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knock-up from Ivern R Daisy!, so tenacity is often the higher priority.
Ivern.fight: Ivern has relatively low magic resistance, so Evelynn’s magic damage is effective against him. If Ivern E Triggerseed is on a target, don’t dash in right away; wait for the shield to pop before engaging.
Ivern.laning: Placing vision in Ivern’s jungle early lets you track his route as he comes to harvest camps he seeded with Ivern P Friend of the Forest.
Ivern.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of vision, then approach while the mark primes. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought his health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his mobility tool, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to close the gap. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, delay your dash until the shield pops.
Ivern.phase: Evelynn has no camouflage early, so her ganks are weak. Focus on farming while using vision to track Ivern’s route as he harvests camps. In late-game fights, don’t focus solely on chasing Ivern deep; look for a chance to pick off an ally of his who has a shield.
Ivern.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active as you circle around from the side or behind. Engage after key crowd control such as Ivern Q Rootcaller is used on your frontline, and don’t fire Evelynn Q Hate Spike at an enemy positioned behind Ivern R Daisy!. Target someone after their shield pops, engage with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges basic attacks and stuns nearby enemies when reactivated, so retreat outside its range. Jax R Grandmaster-at-Arms grants armor and magic resistance, so watch whether he uses it before fighting.
Jax.build: The available information doesn’t specify which item to buy first. Jax deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Attack speed reduction can help, and Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building only health.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, leave its stun range and wait for it to end. After Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are both down, prime Evelynn W Allure; once the mark is primed, trigger it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike and go in.
Jax.laning: If the lane is pushed toward the enemy turret, leaving Jax a long distance to retreat, it gives you time for Evelynn W Allure to prime.
Jax.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of vision and approach while the mark primes. After Jax E Counter Strike ends, trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve dealt enough damage, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Jax.escape: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, retreat outside its stun range and save mobility like Evelynn E Whiplash for that moment. The window to go in again is right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike has ended. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and disengage, not to engage.
Jax.teamfight: Don’t group around Jax and get hit together by the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike. Wait on the side or behind as Evelynn, then go in after Jax E Counter Strike and the enemy’s key crowd control have been used. If Jax is pushing a turret in a side lane, pressure the enemy elsewhere and trade for an objective by splitting your team instead of facing him alone.

JarvanIV.build: Basic attacks and attack speed are also sources of damage, so reducing attack speed can be effective.
JarvanIV.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight, then only move closer until the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve chipped the target down to execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Use empowered Evelynn E Whiplash from an angle that cuts through the clustered formation, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so walk out of its marked blast area and, if possible, stand on top of an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you when you pass through it, so go around the wall. Karthus R Requiem hits regardless of distance, so keep enough health to survive it even after a fight. Karthus P Death Defied lets him cast spells after being killed, so move away from his corpse immediately.
Karthus.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of Karthus’s telegraphed attacks. All of Karthus’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance if you want more defenses. Avoiding Karthus W Wall of Pain and spending less time in Karthus E Defile takes priority over stacking more resistances.
Karthus.fight: Karthus can’t create distance on his own, so cast Evelynn W Allure before approaching and close the gap until the mark matures. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. Avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and walk out of Karthus Q Lay Waste’s marked area.
Karthus.laning: Karthus also has no mobility or immobilizing abilities at this point, so take any early opportunity to disrupt his scaling.
Karthus.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Once you’ve chipped him down to execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and move away from his corpse.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing abilities, so engage when Evelynn W Allure has matured and you can see a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain.
Karthus.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind, engaging when the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Use empowered Evelynn E Whiplash from an angle that cuts through the clustered formation, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat. If you kill Karthus, reposition immediately to avoid Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile while Karthus is in Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.phase: Evelynn’s ganks are weak early, but Karthus also has no mobility or immobilizing ability, giving you a chance to interrupt his scaling. Karthus farms quickly, so if you miss your early opportunities, he can catch up; keep disrupting his farm into mid game, and late game, account for the damage that can remain after killing him.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the linear hitbox of Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Taking damage from it also sets up Kayn to meet the condition for Kayn R Umbral Trespass. When Kayn approaches with Kayn E Shadow Step, stop fighting and retreat if a warning appears along the edge of a wall.
Kayn.build: Build armor first, accounting for the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade’s Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. Be cautious about building a lot of health alone because Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on maximum health. If Kayn transforms into the Darkin and his healing makes him harder to execute, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Kayn.fight: Cast Evelynn W Allure early from out of sight, then manage your distance until the mark matures.
Kayn.laning: At this point, be careful not to give pre-transformation Kayn a kill and speed up his transformation.
Kayn.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and wait for the mark to mature. Trigger the charm with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Once you’ve chipped him down to execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Kayn.escape: Don’t engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is on cooldown; he can still escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Look for a window before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back, after you’ve also dodged Kayn W Blade’s Reach. Then prepare the charm with Evelynn W Allure and close the gap with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
Kayn.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge relative late-game strength. Choose your fights based on Kayn’s transformation form and whether Kayn R Umbral Trespass has been used.
Kayn.teamfight: Evelynn shouldn’t stand in front. Activate Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind. If Kayn uses Kayn R Umbral Trespass on an ally, prepare crowd control for when he emerges near that target.

Kindred.watch: When Kindred E Mounting Dread marks you, create distance or break line of sight so you don’t take repeated hits. Its damage increases as your health gets lower, so don’t stay in a fight for long unless you can use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and disengage at the same time.
Kindred.build: Build armor first to deal with Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If healing from Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb’s Respite keeps disrupting your executes, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Kindred.fight: Before Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy comes back, cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while giving the mark time to mature.
Kindred.laning: Take camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred first, or secure vision nearby to delay Kindred from claiming the mark.
Kindred.combo: Then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike to chip away at their health. Finish with Evelynn R Last Caress once they’re in execute range. If Kindred R Lamb’s Respite is active, survive inside the zone, then use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish after it ends.
Kindred.escape: Don’t engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is on cooldown. Look for a window before Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy comes back, cast Evelynn W Allure early, and once the mark matures, lock them down with the charm before going in with Evelynn E Whiplash.
Kindred.phase: In the mid to late game, Kindred gains more damage and range as they collect marks, so keep delaying their mark collection.
Kindred.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind, engaging after the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Kindred repeatedly uses mobility abilities inside Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy, so when they leave the zone, lock them down with Evelynn W Allure and attack with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If Kindred R Lamb’s Respite is active, survive inside the zone, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress after it ends.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage to isolated targets, so stay near allied champions. When Kha'Zix is out of sight, his next basic attack gains bonus damage and a slow from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat, so secure vision in bushes. When Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay with your allies instead of chasing his position, then look for the moment he reappears.
Khazix.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear, Kha'Zix W Void Spike, and Kha'Zix E Leap. If the retaliation immediately after you engage feels risky, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and use it separately from Evelynn R Last Caress to survive. If Kha'Zix W Void Spike's healing keeps ruining your execute window, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Khazix.fight: Use the moment just after Kha'Zix E Leap is used to engage as your counterattack window. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, wait near your allies and bind him with Evelynn W Allure when he reappears. Reduce his health with Evelynn Q Hate Spike and empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Khazix.laning: On jungle camps, cast Evelynn W Allure on the large monster first, then trigger it once the mark matures.
Khazix.combo: Confirm Kha'Zix E Leap is down, then cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you have lowered his health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Khazix.escape: The moment just after Kha'Zix E Leap is used to engage is your chance to go in. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, wait near your allies for him to reappear.
Khazix.phase: Once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions, starting in mid game, stop acting alone. Stay with your allies in late-game fights as well to prevent isolation.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in areas where you have vision to prevent the isolated damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Approach from the side instead of head-on, but don't venture deep out of sight alone while Kha'Zix is alive. Target the backline when Kha'Zix E Leap is down or the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your frontline, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

LeeSin.watch: Keep your distance from walls, since Lee Sin can cross them with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will when you lack vision beyond them. If Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage could hit you, don't stand on top of an ally.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and R Dragon's Rage. If the retaliation immediately after you engage is too strong, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and use it separately from Evelynn R Last Caress to survive.
LeeSin.fight: If you encounter Lee Sin in the early jungle, back off instead of taking the duel. When fighting, look for a window before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up, and check whether Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is still available.
LeeSin.laning: If you expect a Lee Sin gank, put a minion or jungle monster between you and him to block the straight-line angle for Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, then dash in with empowered E Whiplash and recast Q Hate Spike. Lower the target's health into execute range, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
LeeSin.escape: Your chance to engage is when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or before it comes back up. Lee Sin can also escape with W Safeguard / Iron Will, so don't go in immediately just because one mobility ability is down.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin falls off in the late game, so avoid early duels and buy time through objective and lane advantages.
LeeSin.teamfight: Don't stand at the front. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and circle to the side or behind. Keep your distance so you don't collide with allies knocked back by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage, and engage when the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Pierce the grouped formation with empowered E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

Lillia.watch: Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge in narrow jungle paths, so don't take those routes when you don't know where Lillia is. Being hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or E Swirlseed can make you a target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when you have plenty of health. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!'s cast animation, move sideways to get out of the center of the impact.
Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia's main damage. Lillia Q Blooming Blows' true damage can't be reduced by resistance, and stacking a lot of health alone also increases the damage from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough. If Lillia's healing keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Lillia.fight: Don't force a chase while Lillia has built up movement speed by landing abilities. Dodge her abilities and wait until she has no stacks; right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used, cast Evelynn W Allure in advance to prepare your engage.
Lillia.laning: When you don't know Lillia's position, don't go straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths where her seed is hard to dodge.
Lillia.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. While Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you have lowered her health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Lillia.escape: Your chance to go in comes right after you make Lillia use W Watch Out! Eep!. Dodge her abilities and wait until she has no movement speed stacks, then let Evelynn W Allure mature before engaging. Apply the charm and go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If a Lillia ability hits you and you become drowsy from Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, get to safety before you fall asleep.
Lillia.phase: The available information isn't enough to judge who has the advantage in the late game.
Lillia.teamfight: Don't stand at the front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active as you circle to the side or behind. If Lillia approaches from the side, look for a chance to catch her with allied immobilizing crowd control, and engage after her key crowd control is down. Pierce the grouped enemies with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can't dodge it; approach from outside its range. Once he's on you, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces your armor, and the longer you fight, the more armor and healing Wukong P Stone Skin builds up, so end the trade quickly. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don't waste Evelynn Q Hate Spike on the clone left in place; watch the direction the real Wukong moves.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. However, armor can't block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike. If Wukong's healing keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
MonkeyKing.fight: Evelynn's main magic damage is effective against Wukong's low magic resistance, so you can briefly trade back when he gets on you. Avoid a long duel while Wukong P Stone Skin stacks up, and reduce his health with Evelynn Q Hate Spike and empowered Evelynn E Whiplash before backing off. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and escape when Wukong is in execute range.
MonkeyKing.laning: Cast Evelynn W Allure on the large monster in a camp first, then trigger it once the mark matures.
MonkeyKing.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm Wukong, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Q. When Wukong is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress.
MonkeyKing.escape: Your chance to engage is after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and before he can use it again. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so don't go in immediately just because one mobility ability is down. If Wukong R Cyclone has just been fully spent as well, cast Evelynn W Allure in advance to set up a charm.
MonkeyKing.phase: After that, still avoid fighting Wukong at length and look for an opening when his mobility and Wukong R Cyclone are down.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and circle to the side or behind. Engage after the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Pierce the grouped formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike makes him untargetable while he casts, so don't use your finisher before he lands. Master Yi R Highlander makes him immune to slows, and his basic attacks with Master Yi E Wuju Style deal some true damage. Healing from Master Yi W Meditate can make him harder to execute.
MasterYi.build: True damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style can't be reduced with resistances, so build some health too. If healing from Master Yi W Meditate keeps denying your execute, fit Morellonomicon into your build after finishing one core item.
MasterYi.fight: Bait out Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then look for him as he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, don't rely on slows; use Evelynn R Last Caress to retreat and create distance.
MasterYi.laning: Apply Evelynn W Allure to a large jungle monster in advance, let the mark mature, then pop it. Master Yi has a weak early jungle and ganks, so don't delay taking early objective advantages.
MasterYi.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach until the mark matures. Then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike, and finish with Evelynn R Last Caress once you have reduced health into execute range.
MasterYi.escape: The moment to close the gap is right after Master Yi uses his mobility tool, Q Alpha Strike, and lands. Don't use Evelynn R Last Caress to engage; save it to finish him and escape.
MasterYi.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or rear, entering after the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Look for the moment Master Yi lands after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, time Evelynn W Allure so its mark primes in time to interrupt him with the charm. Avoid situations where an ally is killed alone and reduces Master Yi’s basic ability cooldowns. Finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther it travels, so make a particular effort to dodge it when she throws it from a distance. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack along jungle entrances and in the river, and dodge both the spear and traps to avoid being marked for the hunt. If marked, watch for Nidalee Q Takedown as she closes in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.fight: Dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack to avoid giving her a hunt mark. Then dive in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and whittle her down, finishing with Evelynn R Last Caress when she's in execute range.
Nidalee.laning: Use a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability to reveal and clear Nidalee W Bushwhack traps at jungle entrances and in the river before passing through.
Nidalee.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark matures. Pop the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. When Nidalee is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Nidalee.escape: The moment after Nidalee uses Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to close the gap and catch her. Nidalee has no crowd control, so charm her with Evelynn W Allure and dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. Don't chase her and pop Evelynn W Allure before the mark matures.
Nidalee.phase: The information provided isn't enough to determine which of the two champions has the advantage late game.
Nidalee.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind to position behind the enemy backline carries. Remember where Nidalee stepped out to throw her spear, then engage when the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your frontline. If Nidalee W Pounce is down, catch her with the charm from Evelynn W Allure and pierce the clustered formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
Nidalee.build: If Nidalee E Primal Surge’s healing keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item. If you build resistance against Nidalee’s damage, build magic resistance. Still, dodge a long-range Nidalee Q Javelin Toss even if you have increased your resistance.

Poppy.fight: Don't dash in with Evelynn E Whiplash before Poppy W Steadfast Presence expires. After Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, apply Evelynn W Allure in advance. Once the mark matures, charm her with the longer-ranged Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then dive in with empowered E Whiplash. Poppy gains armor and magic resistance as her health gets lower, so check your finishing damage before fighting.
Poppy.laning: When fighting Poppy, don't position with a wall or narrow passage behind you.
Poppy.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and only approach while the mark matures. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence expires, pop the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, dash in with empowered E Whiplash, then recast Q Hate Spike. When you can finish her, use Evelynn R Last Caress to deal damage and retreat.
Poppy.phase: In late-game team fights, don't stand in front. Wait on the flank or behind for Poppy's crowd control to be used.
Poppy.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind to position behind the enemy backline carries. Don't engage with Evelynn E Whiplash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Look for the moment when Poppy's key crowd control has been used on your frontline. After engaging, find an angle to pierce the clustered formation with empowered E Whiplash, then finish and retreat with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy, and be wary of choosing an item that only adds a lot of health, since Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health.
Poppy.escape: Poppy E Heroic Charge is her only means of mobility, so right after she uses it is your chance to close the distance. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then cast Evelynn W Allure and give its mark time to prime before engaging. If Poppy starts charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move out of her frontal line to avoid being knocked back.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks the dash from Evelynn E Whiplash, so go in after its duration ends. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so stand in open space. If you’re hit by Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the remaining zone immediately. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move aside from in front of her.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up. When you see it, walk toward the direction the snowball is coming from rather than running backward, then escape through the space Nunu & Willump came from. If hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, move away immediately before its delayed root lands. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero applies increasingly strong slows inside its area, so leave the area early if you can't interrupt it.
Nunu.build: Finish one core item first. If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume keeps denying your execute, buy Morellonomicon. If you need defense, build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's main magic damage, and get tenacity to account for the snowball's crowd control.
Nunu.fight: Nunu & Willump can heal with Q Consume, so avoid trades where you deal damage but can't finish him. Once Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has passed and you're clear of the root threat from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, apply Evelynn W Allure in advance and let the mark mature.
Nunu.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark matures. Pop the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Whittle Nunu & Willump down to execute range, then finish and escape with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Nunu.escape: Engage after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has passed and you're clear of the root threat from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on his own, so charm him with Evelynn W Allure and stick to him with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. Don't use Evelynn R Last Caress to engage; save it to finish him and escape.
Nunu.phase: Late game, it's important to enter from the flank after Nunu & Willump's crowd control has been used instead of engaging from the front.
Nunu.teamfight: Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank from the side or behind. Engage on the enemy backline carries when Nunu & Willump's key crowd control has been used on your frontline. If you don't have an angle to interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero with a charm when it starts, leave its area early. Pierce the clustered enemies with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish and escape with Evelynn R Last Caress.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, put minions between you and him. If he uses Rammus R Soaring Slam after rolling in quickly, dodge widely and move away from the landing spot. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents you from moving and using abilities, so approach from outside its range and look for an opening. When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop attacking and wait for it to expire.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first to mitigate the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. If you have to fight Rammus directly, choose percentage penetration to account for the increased resistances from W Defensive Ball Curl.
Rammus.fight: Unload your damage after Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends. If it is active, back off and look for another target.
Rammus.laning: When ganking, choose a lane where the enemy has a long distance to retreat, giving Evelynn W Allure time to mature.
Rammus.combo: Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Q. If you’ve brought them into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Rammus.escape: When Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, look for an opportunity to engage. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, let Evelynn W Allure mature, charm him, then go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If you’ve already been taunted, you can’t use abilities, so judge the distance to be able to move once it wears off.
Rammus.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active, flank or circle behind, and target the enemy backline damage dealers. When you see Rammus Q Powerball and R Soaring Slam, retreat widely. Engage after key crowd control such as Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is used on your frontline. Use empowered Evelynn E Whiplash to cut through clustered enemies, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and disengage.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai burrows, watch for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and move in an open direction away from walls and narrow paths. You can dodge the knock-up with Evelynn R Last Caress’s untargetable state as Rek'Sai emerges. Immediately after Rek'Sai damages you, stay close to your allies because Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai’s main damage. Resistances don’t mitigate the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, while Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If healing from Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai keeps ruining your execute opportunities, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
RekSai.fight: Engage after dodging the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow or after Rek'Sai R Void Rush is used.
RekSai.laning: Avoid giving up kills to Rek'Sai’s early and mid-game ganks: don’t move alone through areas without vision, and walk over visible Tunnel entrances to destroy them.
RekSai.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while its mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Once you’ve brought them into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
RekSai.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel has been used, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so look especially for an opening before Rek'Sai R Void Rush comes back off cooldown. At that point, let Evelynn W Allure mature in advance, charm her, then close the distance with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
RekSai.phase: Even late game, wait for a flank instead of engaging from the front.
RekSai.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and move around from the side or rear to position behind the enemy backline damage dealers. When the enemy’s key crowd control has been used on your frontline, trigger Evelynn W Allure’s mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike and go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If Rek'Sai burrows to approach, watch for the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build resource, so avoid paths next to brush when he’s out of sight. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so avoid fighting him then. When Rengar approaches with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, don’t move alone; overlap your detection range with your allies.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty or after Rengar W Battle Roar has been used. Use Evelynn E Whiplash only after dodging Rengar E Bola Strike.
Rengar.laning: Cast Evelynn W Allure on a camp’s large monster first, then trigger it once the mark matures.
Rengar.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while its mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm the target, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought them into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Rengar.escape: Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike and look to engage right after Rengar W Battle Roar is used. When Rengar’s resource bar is empty, let Evelynn W Allure mature in advance, charm him, then close in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. If he retaliates, dodge the attack with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Rengar.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge relative strength in the late game, so in teamfights, confirm Rengar’s engage before looking for a flank.
Rengar.teamfight: Evelynn shouldn’t stand in front. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and flank or circle behind. When Rengar uses Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt to target your backline, stay near your frontline and within vision to spot his engage. After Rengar W Battle Roar and key crowd control have been used, apply a charm with Evelynn W Allure, go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Rengar.build: Rengar's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you're worried about his counterattack right after you engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Evelynn R Last Caress to survive. If Rengar W Battle Roar's healing keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage from Sejuani P Fury of the North, Q Arctic Assault, and E Permafrost. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance won’t block it. Sejuani P Fury of the North scales with maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Sejuani.fight: Look for an opportunity to engage right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used. While Sejuani P Fury of the North is increasing her defensive stats, deal initial damage with Evelynn Q Hate Spike. When Evelynn W Allure matures, trigger it with Q to charm her and reduce her magic resistance, then go in with Evelynn E Whiplash. Back away as Sejuani E Permafrost stacks build.
Sejuani.laning: Take advantage of Sejuani’s low early kill and damage numbers to pursue early jungle control and objectives, while keeping enough distance to dodge Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and R Glacial Prison.
Sejuani.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while its mark matures. After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Q. Once you’ve brought her into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat backward.
Sejuani.escape: The opening to go in with Evelynn E Whiplash comes right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it wears off to avoid the follow-up basic attack. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and retreat, then back off between fights to activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and empower Evelynn E Whiplash again.
Sejuani.phase: At this stage, look for opportunities to gain early jungle control and take objectives as you level up, delaying Sejuani’s item timings. If you give her time, she’ll build defensive stats and keep locking down your allies, so avoid front-on fights in the late game.
Sejuani.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade, flank or circle behind, and position behind the enemy damage dealers. Engage when key crowd control such as Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and R Glacial Prison has been used on your frontline. Use Evelynn E Whiplash at an angle that cuts through clustered enemies, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Sejuani.watch: Watch out for the knockup from Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and the stun from Sejuani R Glacial Prison. If you see the tell, move sideways to dodge. If you get hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before the second strike. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from the basic attacks of Sejuani's melee allies, so back away when the indicator fills.

Shaco.watch: Watch for Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes where you have no vision and around objectives; clear them in advance with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. Shaco Q Deceive empowers his first basic attack when he gets behind you, so if you think Shaco is nearby, keep your back to a wall or face your allies. When low on health, watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and avoid crossing jungle where you have no vision.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first to mitigate damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate. If Shaco's counterattack is fierce right after you engage, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Evelynn R Last Caress to buy time to survive.
Shaco.fight: The moment right after you force Shaco to use Q Deceive is your chance to close the gap. Watch how health bars react to identify the real Shaco so you don't waste damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate.
Shaco.laning: Keep vision on your jungle entrances to prepare for Shaco's early ganks and invades.
Shaco.combo: Follow with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash to dash in, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you've lowered their health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Shaco.escape: Attack with your allies right after Shaco uses Q Deceive, especially when he uses it to appear in a fight. Check choke points without vision first so you can avoid the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box, then enter along a path where the box has been cleared. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and escape, not to engage.
Shaco.phase: If you avoid giving Shaco kills early, secure objectives, and buy time, his ability to fight alone falls off later.
Shaco.teamfight: Evelynn should avoid the front line. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear, entering after the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your front line. If Shaco appears with Q Deceive, focus the real Shaco immediately with your allies. When the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate dies, step back to avoid the explosion and the box's fear.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable while she is charging, so don't try to stop her mid-flight with Evelynn W Allure; apply the mark after she lands. Watch out for the slow and max-health damage from Shyvana E Molten Burst, and limit how long you stay close so you don't get hit by Shyvana Q Emberstrike.
Shyvana.build: If the enemy's healing keeps ruining your execute opportunities, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item. Build magic resistance first against Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon's Descent, and consider armor to withstand her basic attack damage. Shyvana Q Emberstrike and E Molten Burst deal max-health damage, so think carefully before choosing an option that only adds a lot of health.
Shyvana.laning: Apply Evelynn W Allure to a camp's large monster first, wait for it to become empowered, then trigger it to reduce the health you lose.
Shyvana.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark becomes empowered. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. When Shyvana's health is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Shyvana.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her transformation ends and she returns to human form. You can't interrupt her with a charm while she's flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so cast Evelynn W Allure after she lands, then trigger it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike once the mark is empowered.
Shyvana.phase: As time passes, Shyvana's permanent stacks make her harder to kill with the same engage angle.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit by dragon-form Shyvana's area-of-effect abilities. Evelynn should keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear, entering after the enemy's key crowd control has been used on your front line. After Shyvana R Dragon's Descent lands, look for a charm with Evelynn W Allure, then pierce the clustered enemies with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and finish with Evelynn R Last Caress as you retreat.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty. If it's full, don't start a fight by attacking an objective first. If she engages with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, wait for her to land, then cast Evelynn W Allure, let its mark prime, and charm her. Once the charm lands, dash in with Evelynn E Whiplash to deal damage, then finish her with Evelynn R Last Caress in the execute range.

Skarner.fight: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used is your chance to close the gap. Don't let the fight drag on and take repeated empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: When facing Skarner, choose a route that keeps your back away from walls so you don't get hit by Skarner E Ixtal's Impact.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and wait for the mark to become empowered. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered E Whiplash and recast Q. When Skarner's health is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his only mobility tool, so right after he uses it is an opening for Evelynn to engage. If Skarner R Impale is still available, account for the fact that you can't escape its suppression with a movement ability.
Skarner.phase: As Skarner completes tank items, both his damage and durability increase, so it's important to delay that point with early jungle pressure and objectives.
Skarner.teamfight: Evelynn should avoid the front line, keep Demon Shade active, and flank from the side or rear to target the enemy backline carries. Engage after Skarner's key crowd control has been used on your front line, and look for an angle to pierce a clustered formation with empowered E Whiplash. Even if you plan to escape with Evelynn R Last Caress near an objective, keep your distance while Skarner R Impale is available, since he can pull you in from the edge of the pit.
Skarner.build: Decide whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistances, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about building only health.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and can stun you against a wall. Don't stand with your back to a wall; keep your distance in open space. You can't escape after Skarner R Impale suppresses you with Evelynn R Last Caress, so check whether he's used it before getting within its short range.

Taliyah.watch: Don't use Evelynn E Whiplash or Evelynn R Last Caress to cross the rock minefield. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can't change direction, so dodge it by stepping to the side.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. Consider tenacity too if Taliyah's crowd control keeps locking you down.
Taliyah.fight: If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is active, go around the rock minefield before dashing in with Evelynn E Whiplash. Once you start dealing damage, keep attacking because Taliyah can't escape with R Weaver's Wall.
Taliyah.laning: If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may be able to affect another lane, so back off in advance.
Taliyah.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of sight and approach while the mark matures. Trigger the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with Evelynn E Whiplash along a path without the rock minefield and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you've lowered her health into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Taliyah.phase: Later in the game, wait on the flank for Taliyah's crowd control to be used instead of engaging from the front.
Taliyah.teamfight: Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active, flank from the side or rear, and position behind the enemy backline carries. Engage after key crowd control such as Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth has been used on your front line, and don't use Evelynn E Whiplash over the rock minefield. Pierce a clustered formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress as you retreat.
Taliyah.escape: When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall are both available, don't engage just because one is down. Look for a moment when Taliyah R Weaver's Wall hasn't come back up yet and the crowd control from Taliyah W Seismic Shove is also down. Take a route without the rock field, let Evelynn W Allure's mark prime, then close the distance with Evelynn E Whiplash.

Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch for the stun. While E is Awakened, don’t try to catch him with Evelynn W Allure. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t fight him up close for long.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage, but keep in mind armor won’t block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Udyr.fight: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then engage after you’ve already taken the stun or when its Awakened state ends. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is removed, press the attack without giving him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, don’t step forward in lane. Track his movements with vision on key paths and jungle entrances.
Udyr.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure on Udyr from out of vision and approach until the mark is ready. Detonate it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought him into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to engage. Immobilizing effects don’t work while E is Awakened, so wait for that state to end, then catch him with Evelynn W Allure and go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, don’t try to melt Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Take out the weaker enemies behind him, then fight with your numbers advantage.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear. Engage on the weaker enemies behind the frontline when key crowd control, including Udyr E Blazing Stampede, has been used on your allies up front. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish after lowering their health, then escape.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage the longer it charges, so move backward or to the side to dodge when you see her charging. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and increases attack speed through repeated attacks, so don’t fight her for long. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target all the way to stun and knock them up, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash.
Vi.fight: Close the distance right after dodging or baiting out Vi Q Vault Breaker. If she engages with Vi P Blast Shield active, trade after the shield is gone. Wait for the mark from Evelynn W Allure to be ready, then attack briefly and avoid a prolonged fight where Vi W Denting Blows can ramp up.
Vi.laning: Cast Evelynn W Allure on large monsters first, then detonate it once the mark is ready.
Vi.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure on Vi from out of vision and only approach until the mark is ready. Detonate it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought her into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Vi.escape: The moment after you dodge or bait out Vi Q Vault Breaker is your window to engage. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, she can’t be stopped while charging in, so time your next move for after the landing and knock-up end. Use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and escape; while casting, you become untargetable and can avoid targeted attacks that haven’t reached you yet.
Vi.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage late game, so act when Vi’s crowd control is down.
Vi.teamfight: Evelynn shouldn’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear. Go for the enemy backline carries when key crowd control, including Vi R Cease and Desist, has been used on your allies up front. Against a grouped formation, line up empowered Evelynn E Whiplash to pierce through them. When they’re in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Vi.build: Build armor first against Vi's main damage. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If her counterattack comes right after you engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Evelynn R Last Caress.

Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it charges, so move to the side when you see him charging. If a mark from Evelynn W Allure is ready, detonate it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to interrupt his charge. When your health is low, retreat because Viego R Heartbreaker can target you.
Viego.fight: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down; look for a window before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back. Lower his health with Evelynn Q Hate Spike and empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Viego.laning: If you see the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path on terrain, avoid that path and don’t let the lane push toward it.
Viego.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of vision and approach until the mark is ready. Detonate it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Once his health is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Viego.escape: Even if Viego W Spectral Maw is down, don’t rush in while Viego R Heartbreaker is still available. In particular, go in before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back when you can prepare Evelynn W Allure in advance and charm him. Close the distance with Evelynn E Whiplash, and use Evelynn R Last Caress to finish and escape.
Viego.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage late game. In fights, look for a window after Viego’s mobility and stun are down.
Viego.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear. Engage after key crowd control, such as Viego W Spectral Maw, has been used on your allies up front. Pierce a grouped formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape. If an ally falls in front of Viego, don’t keep fighting there; create distance so Viego can’t reach the wraith.
Viego.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If his counterattack is strong right after you engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. If the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King keeps ruining your execute window, buy Morellonomicon after completing one core item.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the later thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered attacks, use Evelynn R Last Caress to create distance before the third hit knocks you up. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t deal damage from outside spear range; wait for its duration to end.
XinZhao.build: Complete one core item first. Against Xin Zhao’s main damage, build armor first for resistance. If healing from Xin Zhao P Determination keeps preventing your executes, reduce his healing next with Morellonomicon.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning to the side, then close the distance after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s damage immunity is active, create distance and wait it out before attacking again.
XinZhao.laning: Cast Evelynn W Allure on a camp’s large monster first, let the mark become ready, then detonate it.
XinZhao.combo: Cast Evelynn W Allure from out of vision and approach until the mark is ready. Detonate it with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. If you’ve brought Xin Zhao into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you bait out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is Evelynn’s window to engage. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, create distance until its immunity ends.
XinZhao.phase: In late-game teamfights, the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends is your chance to counterattack.
XinZhao.teamfight: Don’t stand in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and flank from the side or rear to target the enemy backline carries. When Xin Zhao dives in, the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard can split your formation, so don’t stand too close to your allies. Engage after the immunity from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends and the enemy’s key crowd control is used, and look for an angle to pierce a grouped formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.

Zac.watch: When you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot’s charging animation, move away from where he will land. You can apply Evelynn W Allure early to interrupt the charge when the charm triggers, but before the mark matures, it only slows him. Once Zac gets close, create distance to avoid Zac W Unstable Matter damage.
Zac.build: Complete one core item first. If Zac’s healing keeps making it difficult to execute him, add Morellonomicon. If you need more resistance, build magic resistance to counter Zac’s magic damage.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used, Evelynn has a chance to close the gap. Walk over the chunks Zac leaves behind to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Apply Evelynn W Allure to the large monster in the camp first, then detonate it once the mark matures.
Zac.combo: Follow up with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash to dash in, then recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Lower the target’s health into execute range, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Zac.escape: Engage right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is used. Apply Evelynn W Allure early and let it mature, then charm Zac to lock him down and close the gap with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash. Save Evelynn R Last Caress for finishing and escaping, rather than engaging.
Zac.phase: The available information is not enough to determine which side is stronger late game.
Zac.teamfight: Avoid standing in front. Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and circle around from the flank or rear. Weather Zac’s engage while creating distance, then go for the enemy backline damage dealers after their key crowd control has been used on your frontline. Check Zac’s revival state before the fight, and use Evelynn’s area damage to deal with his split chunks when they get close.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and will trigger fear, so hold Evelynn’s burst and back off. Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you on hit, leaving you unable to act, and its range increases with his movement speed, so keep plenty of distance from areas without vision.
Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Armor is also useful because his basic attacks deal physical damage. If Warwick’s healing keeps ruining your execute chances, finish one core item, then fit in Morellonomicon.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t spend your burst; look for another opening after the fear triggers. Warwick heals more at low health, so don’t chase deep just because he is at half health. Charm him with Evelynn W Allure, then lower his health with Q Hate Spike and empowered E Whiplash. Finish with R Last Caress when he is in execute range.
