Warwick.laning: When your health falls below half, your location is revealed to Warwick and his movement speed and attack speed from Warwick W Blood Hunt increase. If you have lost a lot of health, give up some farming and recall.
Warwick.combo: Apply Evelynn W Allure from out of vision and approach while the mark matures. After Warwick E Primal Howl’s fear has been used, detonate the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm him, dash in with empowered E Whiplash, then recast Q. When his health is in execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and retreat.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is on cooldown. Wait until Warwick R Infinite Duress is unavailable and the fear from E Primal Howl has also been used. In that window, apply Evelynn W Allure early to prepare the charm, then close the gap with empowered E Whiplash.
Warwick.teamfight: Evelynn should stay out of the front line. Activate P Demon Shade, then wait on the flank or behind the enemy for their key crowd control to be used on your frontline. Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach from far away when his movement speed is high, so watch the far side of the pit where you have no vision during objective standoffs. Right after Warwick suppresses an ally with R, Warwick is also locked in place, so you can focus your counterattack on him.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you airborne and helps refresh Bel'Veth Q Void Surge. When Bel'Veth gets close, turn to the side instead of running straight back to avoid Bel'Veth W Above and Below. Bel'Veth takes greatly reduced damage while E Royal Maelstrom is active, so deal your burst after it ends.
Belveth.build: Build armor first because Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet deals true damage, which resistance cannot mitigate, so survive it with a larger health pool. If Bel'Veth’s healing keeps ruining your execute chances, finish one core item, then fit in Morellonomicon.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below to the side, then deal damage after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends. Bel'Veth cannot immediately use Bel'Veth Q Void Surge again in the direction she just dashed, so look for an opening then.
Belveth.combo: Apply Evelynn W Allure from out of vision and approach while the mark matures. Detonate the mark with Evelynn Q Hate Spike to charm her, then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash and recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike. After Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends, if health has been reduced into execute range, finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
Belveth.escape: Don’t go in immediately just because Bel'Veth has used one cast of Q Void Surge. Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then, while Bel'Veth cannot dash again in the direction of the Bel'Veth Q Void Surge she just used, detonate the matured Evelynn W Allure with Evelynn Q Hate Spike.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth’s stacks are permanent and make her stronger over time, so don’t expect to catch her late game with the same openings as early on.
Belveth.teamfight: Keep Evelynn P Demon Shade active and circle around from the flank or rear. Engage after key crowd control, such as Bel'Veth W Above and Below, has been used on your frontline. Don’t use your burst while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active; after it ends, use empowered Evelynn E Whiplash to cut through the clustered formation. If an ally falls and drops Void Coral, retreat before Bel'Veth can collect it, and delay the teamfight while Bel'Veth is transformed.

Nocturne.watch: If you are hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, he can chase along its trail, so don’t run in a straight line; angle toward an ally or turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror only fears you if the tether stays connected, so save a chance to create distance with Evelynn E Whiplash or Evelynn R Last Caress. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens the screen, don’t run off alone; move toward your allies immediately.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first to prepare for Nocturne’s main damage. If the retaliation right after you engage is too strong, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Evelynn R Last Caress. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades keeps making it difficult to execute him, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, strip the spell shield first with Evelynn Q Hate Spike, then let Evelynn W Allure mature to set up a charm.
Nocturne.laning: Apply Evelynn W Allure to the large monster in the camp in advance, let it mature, then detonate it.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is ready, strip the spell shield first with Evelynn Q Hate Spike. Then dash in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, recast Evelynn Q Hate Spike, and finish with Evelynn R Last Caress when he is in execute range.
Nocturne.escape: The window after Nocturne R Paranoia’s dash is used is your chance to engage. If Nocturne used E Unspeakable Horror, break the tether to avoid the fear, then look for another opening. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness has also been removed, let Evelynn W Allure mature to charm and lock him down, then go in with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash.
Nocturne.phase: The available information is not enough to determine which champion is stronger late game.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia shrouds the area in darkness, move toward your allies immediately so you aren’t exposed alone. Evelynn should avoid standing in front. Activate Evelynn P Demon Shade and circle around from the flank or rear; engage as soon as the enemy’s key crowd control is used on your frontline. Cut through the clustered formation with empowered Evelynn E Whiplash, then finish with Evelynn R Last Caress and escape.
